input_preservation: All represented values equal exact rational fixtures; all neighboring masses remain distinct; minimum relative separation is beyond53bits.

oracle.coefficient_convention: [t_mass^a t_eta^b], equal to partial derivatives divided by a! b!
coordinates: eta+t_eta in invariants and all mass offsets; m_i=M+t_mass+c_i*(eta+t_eta)
oracle.expansion_variable: z=eta/M; mass dependence retained exactly before differentiation

integrated_series_cache.scope: process-local exact structural series keyed by offset pattern and inclusive order

oracle.method: Independent routing-derived Symanzik parameter series; exact Symbolica polynomial integration and normalized derivatives
oracle.normalization: D0=integral_Delta3 (M+eta*R)^(-2) dx, volume(Delta3)=1/6; all pole components zero
oracle.parameter_bound: R=P+sum_i c_i*x_i, c=[-1,0,1,2]; 0<=P<=1 and -1<=sum_i c_i*x_i<=2, hence -1<=R<=3 and |R|<=3
oracle.remainder_proof: Coefficientwise absolute values of every omitted eta-series term and all normalized common-mass/eta derivatives are majorized by the positive generator, retaining the factor 3^k in each term; |M|>=L and |R|<=3 uniformly, then integrate with volume 1/6
oracle.rounding: Exact Complex<Rational> centers and Rational bounds; no floating-point evaluation
